messages:
Maya (PM): quick design sync — usage rail when account scope is selected: show full project rows or condensed org sparkline + project peek pills? support keeps getting tickets about project sums vs invoice.
Rohan (Design): vote for condensed by default: org sparkline + up to 4 muted project pills. pills expand to rows. keeps canvas light.
Tess (Frontend): agree. mobile perf is the main reason — don't render many sparklines at load. lazy-load on expand, + show +N on pills.
Diego (Data): aggregation: use sum for spend, show absolute tokens and percent delta next to number (e.g., 12.4k \u25b24.1%). consider optional 7-day MA smoothing for noisy projects.
Ian (Billing): invoice mismatch sources: credits, proration, allocation rules. modal "How totals map to invoices" should list reasons and link to CSV export.
Nina (Support): customers ask "why aren't my project totals equal to invoice?" Recommend modal copy: short bullets + link to raw line items.
Rohan (Design): microcopy: header = "Tokens billed" with tooltip: "Billing units for requests and responses." keeps it simple.
Tess (Frontend): accessibility: sparklines need aria-labels (min/max/last). tooltips must be keyboard-focusable. color contrast >= 4.5:1.
Diego (Data): UX nicety: pill hover popover shows project spend vs invoice-linked amount + "View mapping" CTA. lightweight context.
Ian (Billing): backend: will add invoice_mapping endpoint, cache results for 24h. generation can be heavier — paginate if many projects.
Maya (PM): decisions: 1) condensed org sparkline + up to 4 project pills; 2) "Expand projects" fetches per-project sparklines; 3) add "How totals map to invoices" modal + pill popover; 4) token header: "Tokens billed" + tooltip; 5) accessibility: aria labels + keyboard tooltips; 6) backend: invoice_mapping endpoint + caching.
Nina (Support): I'll draft modal copy and FAQ blurb for release notes.
recon-bot: invoice INV-2024-11-01 for acct:ACME uploaded — https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2024-11-01
Maya (PM): thanks — I'll update mocks and write acceptance criteria. sync Monday for final review.
